name: Kanokogi Nagi
source:
A young associate professor who serves as the assistant advisor to the Regional Culture Research Club.

She has always had a researcher’s mindset, having been interested in the unique cultures and customs of different regions since her student days. On the other hand, her general life skills are lacking, and she sometimes holds others back.

She talks to herself a lot, and when she gets absorbed in something, she tends to lose sight of her surroundings.
